name: Nom Nom
author: Nikola Babic
summary: Keeps a meal and calorie log, remembers named recipes, and sends a daily summary of what you recorded.
starterPrompt: Help me start a food log. Ask about portions and ingredients, save meals I repeat as named recipes, and explain how you estimate the daily total.
usageNote: Calorie totals are estimates. Check serving sizes and ingredients, and use the bot as a personal food log rather than a diet prescription.
